Name: Unlimited Players
Author: Armitxes
Description:
[center] [/center][center][size=4][url=https://armitxes.net/Project/StardewValley/UnlimitedPlayers]Official Project Website[/url]﻿ | [url=https://armitxes.net/Project/StardewValley/UnlimitedPlayers]Installation Guide[/url]﻿﻿ | [url=https://github.com/Armitxes/StardewValley_UnlimitedPlayers]Source Code[/url] | [url=https://github.com/Armitxes/StardewValley_UnlimitedPlayers/issues?q=is%3Aopen]Issues[/url]﻿[/size][/center][url=https://github.com/Armitxes/StardewValley_UnlimitedPlayers]
[/url]
[list]
[*][b]Only the host (server) requires the mod.[/b]
[list]
[*] Players (clients) will be able to join you with the regular client aswell as the SMAPI Client.
[/list][*]This mod circumvents the hard player limit mentioned by the game devs (i.e. at Reddit)
[*][color=#e06666][b]Got any Issues?[/b][/color] [b][color=#b6d7a8]Check out the "Got an Issue?" Tab on the project website before you open a bug report / forum discussion![/color][/b]
[/list]

[b]Current features[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed cabin limit for host
[*]Removed player limit in multiplayer class
[*]Removed player network limit
[*]Client Mods
[list]
[*](Console) Get info about which mods a player uses when joining your server/farm.
[*](Optional) Deny players with certain mods (i.e. cheat mods) from joining your server.
[/list][*]Console commands
[list]
[*]bank statement: Print bank statement about all players with their uid and balance
[*]bank suslist: Print bank statement of players with suspicious balance
[*]bank wipe <uid>: Wipe account balance of the provided uid
[/list][/list]
[b]Installation
[/b][list]
[*]Mind the requirements
[*]Unzip the provided zip in your Stardew Valley Mods folder (so that it is in an own folder)
[*]Open the delivered config file and set the player / cabin limit to whatever you want.
[/list]
[b]Usage[/b]
[list]
[*]Go to the Carpenter, build as many cabins as you like (as host)
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Access to the latest Stardew Valley Beta
[*]SMAPI: [url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io/[/url]﻿
[/list]

[b]A final note:
[/b]This mod is being kept simple and doesn't change too much on the gamecode. It's thereby pretty safe from compatibility issues.
Yet the whole MP mode is pretty new so Chucklefish / Concerned Ape are active in changing the MP code - this can lead to unexpected behaviours and changing (planned) features which, if any appear, are fixed and / or adjusted as quick as possible.

Thanks for your understanding.
